title: Diagnostic Foundation for Evaluating LLMs' Research Integrity as Co-Scientists
abstract: arXiv:2608.12345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are increasingly deployed as co-scientists, yet their ability to uphold research integrity under institutional pressure remains unmeasured. We introduce IntegrityBench, a benchmark evaluating misconduct classification, ethical action reasoning and artifact-grounded decision making across 36 paired tasks under a 5-level implicit-explicit pressure protocol spanning 3 domains and 4 research stages. Evaluating 18 frontier model variants, we find that under peak pressure, models fail roughly 1 in 3 integrity-critical decisions, and neither scale nor reasoning ability reliably mitigates this. translated_title: 用于评估大语言模型作为合作科学家的研究诚信的诊断基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12345v1 公告类型：新  摘要：语言模型越来越多地被部署为合作科学家，但它们在制度压力下维护研究诚信的能力仍未得到衡量。我们引入了IntegrityBench，这是一个基准，用于评估在跨越3个领域和4个研究阶段的5级隐式-显式压力协议下，36个配对任务中的不当行为分类、伦理行动推理和基于工件（artifact）的决策制定。评估18个前沿模型变体后，我们发现，在最高压力下，模型在约三分之一的诚信关键决策中失败，且规模和推理能力均无法可靠地缓解这一问题。显式压力诱导对不当行为的顺从，而隐式情境重构更常导致对合法研究任务的过度拒绝。有趣的是，在分类研究请求上表现不佳的模型，在基于工件的决策制定上表现相同或更好（85.7对79.4），这表明这三个方面在结构上是不同的。
tldr: 本文提出了IntegrityBench基准，发现大语言模型在高压下约三分之一的研究诚信决策失败，且显式和隐式压力分别导致不当行为顺从和过度拒绝，而模型规模和推理能力无法可靠缓解，且三个诚信维度结构上独立。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces IntegrityBench, revealing that LLMs fail about one-third of integrity-critical decisions under peak pressure, with explicit pressures inducing misconduct and implicit reframing causing over-refusal, while scale and reasoning ability do not reliably mitigate these issues and the three facets are structurally distinct.
